bibl.title: P.Oxy. 2163 fr. 1: interpretazioni sceniche sul silenzio di Achille.
bibl.seg: Daniela Immacolata Cagnazzo, P.Oxy. 2163 fr. 1: interpretazioni sceniche sul silenzio di Achille.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. XVIII, 2163 + P.S.I. XV, 1472 (= MP3 33; LDAB 124), fr. 1, attests a characterization of the veiled, seated, and twisted main character of the Myrmidones. Thanks to this, it is possible to underline the silence typology, body language and performative elements of Achilles' character. Aeschylus creates an innovative theatre in which the absence of sound expresses feelings better than speeches do.
